did_you_know: The tang on the back of the Buddha's head shows that it originally had a halo.
description: This image of the newborn Buddha is rare and unusual. The common type represents him taking seven steps while proclaiming "I am supreme in the Universe." Here, he is represented as being bathed by the nine Nagas, with both hands down.
